selection: One shared long/short line selected by highest development total net R on the common-ready clock, including none; ties follow arms order. Exclude censored and cross-split trades. ETH and separate directions are descriptive checks, not separate production policies.
common_warmup_sensitivity: All seven arms require all six MA values ready; EMA requires 10*N contiguous valid completed higher bars. Actual scope also runs each line's own readiness. No admission or unknown silently imputed.
acceptance: Selected non-baseline line must have positive later total net R, positive improvement over baseline in both net R and nominal net return, monthly-block net R delta lower95>0 and one-sided exact sign-flip p<0.01, retention of at least85percent of original later realized10R winners when present, and positive actual-scope delta in R and nominal return. One pooled selected-line primary test; ETH, directions and full grid are exploratory. Research evidence never promotes or changes Pine defaults.
entry_rule: 5m confirmation close strictly above last completed15m MA for long, below for short; equality and unknown reject
htf_visibility: 15m close_time <= 5m bar OPEN; original Pine offset plus lookahead_on timing. No evolving15m candle or later close at the same5m close is used.
unchanged: V9 raw opposite exits; next-open entry; original5bar/0.2ATR/min2ATR stop; close2R arms4ATR trail;0.2percent round trip; single position per symbol for each complete two-sided replay
